issues.legal_issue: The Limitation Act, including its provisions on acknowledgment of liability, applies to recovery proceedings under the Public Premises (Eviction of Unauthorised Occupants) Act.

A written acknowledgment that payment is being withheld until pending litigation concludes can acknowledge liability and extend the limitation period under Section 18 of the Limitation Act, even when accompanied by a refusal to pay immediately.
A High Court should defer deciding recovery proceedings whose outcome depends on the result of pending appeals concerning the retrospective validity of the underlying tariff revision.
